name: dayflow-qa
description: Independent QA test repository for DayFlow — API/integration, web E2E, and (future) mobile UI tests, run against QA's own isolated stack.

scripts.stack:up: npm run checkout:dev-ref && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml --env-file .env.test up -d --build && node scripts/wait-for-health.mjs
scripts.stack:reset-api: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml --env-file .env.test restart api-qa && node scripts/wait-for-health.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
